```python
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# Additional focused runs to stabilize the speed effect near the upper certified end
more_speeds = [1.0, 1.2]
more_summary = []
for s in more_speeds:
    df = env.experiment(config={"speed": s}, n=60)
    more_summary.append({
        "speed": s,
        "n": len(df),
        "mean_y": float(df["y"].mean()),
        "var_y": float(df["y"].var())
    })
    print(f"speed={s}")
    print(df.head())
    print(df.shape)

more_summary = pd.DataFrame(more_summary)
print("\nadditional summary:")
print(more_summary)

# Aggregate all speed summaries collected so far
base = pd.DataFrame([
    {"speed": 0.8, "n": 40, "mean_y": 5.400},
    {"speed": 0.9, "n": 40, "mean_y": 6.075},
    {"speed": 1.1, "n": 40, "mean_y": 8.150},
    {"speed": 1.2, "n": 40, "mean_y": 7.800},
    {"speed": 1.0, "n": 200, "mean_y": 6.245},  # observational archive at speed 1.0
])
all_means = pd.concat([base, more_summary[["speed", "n", "mean_y"]]], ignore_index=True)
agg = all_means.groupby("speed").apply(lambda g: pd.Series({
    "total_n": g["n"].sum(),
    "weighted_mean": np.average(g["mean_y"], weights=g["n"])
})).reset_index()
print("\naggregated means:")
print(agg)

# Fit log(mean) = a + b * speed by weighted least squares on aggregated means
x = agg["speed"].to_numpy()
y = np.log(agg["weighted_mean"].to_numpy())
w = agg["total_n"].to_numpy()
X = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x), x])
beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X * np.sqrt(w[:, None]), y * np.sqrt(w), rcond=None)[0]
a, b = beta
print("\nlog-mean fit coefficients:", {"a": float(a), "b": float(b)})
print("Predicted means by speed:")
for s in [0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4]:
    print(s, float(np.exp(a + b*s)))
